product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips 7 Piece Glass Bowl Set
features: Set includes: Four 10 oz. Glass Bowls, 4.5 Qt Glass bowl, 2.5 Qt Glass Bowl & 1.5 Qt Glass Bowl. Perfect for prepping, mixing, serving and storing
Wide rims provide easy handling while mixing, pouring and cleaning; carefully calibrated side walls let you mix with minimal splatter

The OXO better Guarantee: if you experience an issue with your OXO product, get in touch with US for a repair or replacement. We’re grateful for the opportunity to Learn from your experience, and we’ll make it better.
description: From prepping dry ingredients, to mixing cake batter, to storing buttercream in the fridge, with the OXO good grips 7-Piece glass bowl set, the possibilities are endless. Durable borosilicate glass can be heated from 32°f (0 °C) to 450° F (232 °C) without the risk of shattering. Wide rims and optimally calibrated side walls provide spill-proof mixing, pouring and transporting. Clean, elegant design means these are bowls equally at home on the kitchen countertop or dining room table. When you’re finished, the set nests for simple storage. Includes Four 10 oz. Glass Bowls, 4.5 Qtr. Glass bowl, 2.5 Qtr. Glass Bowl & 1.5 Qtr. Glass Bowl
